newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SWISS CARGO PLANS NEW EX-GENEVA, BRUSSELS, BASLE.
newsitem.headline: SWISS CARGO PLANS NEW EX-GENEVA, BRUSSELS, BASLE.

text.p: Swiss Cargo, the cargo arm of Swissair, said it planned to operate new full-freighter services from Brussels, Geneva and Basle from the forthcoming winter season, beginning end-October, as well as upgrading existing ones.

"While we have finalised our freighter plans, they remain subject to government approval on traffic rights and for this reason we will not be going into detail at this stage." a Zurich-based Swiss Cargo official told Reuters.
He said it was possible Swiss Cargo would be providing more fuller information on its plans some time next week.
"It's likely we'll be calling on our established full-freighter partners in realising these developments in our cargo traffic," the official added.
Swiss Cargo currently wet-leases McDonnell Douglas DC10Fs operated by Gemini Air Cargo flying Basle-Dakar-Sao Paulo-Dakar-Basle; Geneva-Dubai-Singapore-Madras-Dubai-Geneva and Basle-Chicago-Basle.
It operates a Boeing 747F in conjunction with Korean Air (KAL ) on a Basle-Delhi-Seoul-Delhi-Dubai-Basle routing as well as a Brussels-New York 747F service on behalf of Belgian carrier, Sabena.

In mid-July it was announced that Swissair was negotiating the purchase of a 24.5 percent in the Luxembourg-based all-cargo airline, Cargolux from Lufthansa Cargo. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
